Sofia / Marissa — quick technical clarifications so we don't chase folks later:

1) Tokenization / prompt shape
   - Send a small sample of 100 requests with prompt_token_count and response_token_count (CSV). If you can't, give percentiles: mean / p50 / p90 / p99.
2) Response types
   - For streaming vs non-streaming, we need % streaming and whether streaming is incremental tokens or chunked attachments.
3) Peak burst profile
   - Are bursts sudden (within 1–2 minutes) or ramped (15–30 minutes)? Also provide expected sustained peak duration (minutes-hours).
4) Latency SLOs & fallback policy
   - Confirm p50/p95/p99 goals and if automatic fallback to a smaller model during overload is acceptable.
5) Session model & KV cache
   - If ~12% is chat-like, how big are contexts (tokens) you plan to keep in KV cache per session? We need average context length and typical session duration.
6) Model choices & quantization
   - Preferred families (Llama2, Falcon, Mistral, etc.), target quantization (8-bit/4-bit) — this materially changes GPU footprints.
7) Multimodal flow
   - For image-enriched flows, are images pre-processed (embeddings) or decoded on generation path? Estimate payload size.
8) Reliability expectations
   - Do you require dedicated-zonal isolation, or multi-az redundant capacity? Also call out any compliance constraints if this will be used with regulated data.

If they can answer these 8 quick items, we can produce a baseline SKU matrix (GPUs, expected throughput, cost) within 48 hours. For now I'll assume: 180 average response tokens, 30 average prompt tokens, burst windows are 5–15 minutes with sudden spikes, and p95 target 300ms for stateless requests. If those assumptions are off, please flag.

-Karthik
Principal Inference Architect | Redwood Inference

Thanks — attached is a 24h sample we exported (sample-traffic-0912.csv) and a short summary below. Also added a Miro link with our expected peak windows.

Summary (24h sample):
- Total requests: 1,320,412
- Median requests/minute: 740
- Peak 5-minute window: 25,400 requests (sustained ~7 minutes)
- Typical prompt tokens: mean 28, p90 52, p99 110
- Typical response tokens: mean 172, p90 360, p99 820
- Streaming: ~18% of requests, chunked streaming (client-side render)
- Chat-like sessions: ~10% of total, average KV context kept: 6 turns (~320 tokens)
- Image enrichment: ~1.5% of calls, images are pre-uploaded and embeddings fetched prior to generation (adds ~60ms prep latency)
- Latency SLO: target p95 <= 300ms for stateless prompts; p95 <= 600ms acceptable for multimodal flows

Attachments: sample-traffic-0912.csv (CSV, 2.1MB)
Links: https://miro.com/meridian/peak-windows-0912

Let us know if the attached CSV is enough or if you want a larger slice. Happy to join the sizing workshop Sept 14.

—Liam
